small joys that make
ordinary days feel special

the first sip of coffee

drink your first coffee slowly, sitting down, with nothing else to do. it's a tiny pause, but it turns the start of an ordinary day into a quiet ritual.

learning one beautiful thing

learn one lovely fact every day, about a star, a painting or an old myth. a tiny moment of wonder makes even the greyest day feel a little more special.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning one beautiful thing

i learn one beautiful thing every morning, a star or an old myth. i do it with the Sophia app, 5 minutes a day, and even grey days now hold a small moment of wonder.

slides.texte_overlay:
a walk without headphones

take a short walk and simply listen to the world: birds, voices, wind in the trees. it's surprising how alive an ordinary street feels when you really pay attention to it.

fresh sheets

change your sheets and get into a freshly made bed at night. it's one of the cheapest and most underrated small luxuries that any of us can enjoy at home.

a song you loved at fifteen

play a song you loved as a teenager and let yourself sing along. a few minutes of pure nostalgia can turn a heavy day into a surprisingly happy, light one.
